let literal: 1 | 2 = 1;
literal += 1;
literal *= 3;
const bag: {value: 1 | 2; indexed: 1 | 2} = {value: 1, indexed: 2};
bag.value += 2;
bag['indexed'] *= 2;
console.log(literal, bag.value, bag.indexed);
let word: `a${string}` = 'a';
word += 'b';
let logic: number | string = 0;
logic ||= 'left';
let coalesce: number | string | undefined = undefined;
coalesce ??= 'middle';
let truthy: number | string = 1;
truthy &&= 'right';
console.log(word, logic, coalesce, truthy);
class WideSetter {
  get value(): number { return 1; }
  set value(input: number | string) { console.log(input); }
}
const wide = new WideSetter();
wide.value += 'dot';
wide['value'] += 'index';
